trigger.description: A read-only BV robot-source command exits successfully but writes no stdout for the JSON parser.
setup_commands: # run swarm brief or work-packet with a bv command wrapper that exits 0 and emits empty stdout

expected_emission.repair_string: Retry `bv --robot-triage --robot-triage-by-track` with the configured command timeout, or fall back to `br --no-auto-import --allow-stale ready --json`.
